name: Julia Stoschek Foundation (Julia Stoschek Collection / JSC Berlin)
known: W Magazine (Diane Solway, 20 November 2017) says Stoschek is "an active shareholder" in her family's auto-parts company Brose, whose chairman is her father Michael Stoschek.
Autonomous non-profit foundation gGmbH with transparent public reporting and curatorial independence.

name: KW Institute for Contemporary Art
known: Emma Enderby has been director since May 2024 (the space's about page).

name: Künstlerhaus Bethanien
known: Bethanien names its partners and funders on one undated page but posts no annual reports, accounts or board; its team page names two directors.

name: Neuer Berliner Kunstverein (n.b.k.)
known: Directors: Lucie Schauer from 1975 to 1994, Alexander Tolnay from 1995 and Marius Babias from 2008 (German Wikipedia).

name: SAVVY Contemporary: The Laboratory of Form-Ideas
known: Bonaventure Soh Bejeng Ndikung was artistic director until 2022, Renan Laru-an from 2023 to 2025.
Lema Sikod and Lynhan Balatbat-Helbock are now executive directors (SAVVY website).
Wikipedia calls Ndikung the founding director of SAVVY Contemporary and says he was to take over the Haus der Kulturen der Welt (HKW) in Berlin on 1 January 2023.
The board page of SAVVY friends e.V., the space's friends' association, names him as founder and chairperson of SAVVY Contemporary.
Its chairman is the artist Thomas Eller Wang and its treasurer is Wolfgang von Dallwitz.
